claims.statement: Pope Sixtus IV and Naples fight Florence. Lorenzo travels to Naples in December 1479 and secures peace in March 1480.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Standard chronologies of the period.
